scope: All five semantic-positive decisions of outputs/decomposition_strict_screen_20b on the frozen 12-row error-heavy development screen.
method: Manual full-context reason audit. Gold labels and prior annotations were not model inputs. A row is reason-correct when at least one stated material reason is correct; unrelated possible errors are not substituted.

summary.interpretation: The strict prompt improved screen labels but not reason fidelity: its two new TP and both remaining FP rely on false or unproved premises. This is a development-screen diagnostic, not population RP.

rows.assessment: Still compares 28/29-May p80 prices with the candidate's 26-May itinerary and calls the available 795 calculation absent. Cross-date evidence does not refute the quoted 26-May prices.
The exact requested network-mode sequence is already supplied by the user; calling the candidate's 4g_5g_preferred step an unsourced subjective recommendation is a wrong evidence-to-claim transition.

Candidate contains two tool calls in one turn; selected policy p0 explicitly permits only one tool call at a time. This is a correct material reason, independently of the gold explanation's false-escalation issue.

The claimed lack of evidence for approve_credit_limit_increase_5847 is false in full context: the retrieved procedure names that tool. The actual approval-precondition issue needs omitted balance/tier/workflow evidence and was not identified.

OBUT9V is the requested reservation, its stored baggage total is one so the candidate total two is consistent with adding one, and the user confirmed flight changes before requesting baggage. The narrower missing baggage action-details confirmation was not stated.

limitations: Single reviewer and inspected development slice.
Correct binary labels do not validate their reasons.
Fallback negatives are excluded from the Reason Precision denominator, not treated as verified explanations.
